title: Sebastian and the Orbit
author: Casper Halloran
blurb: Odile Dravenmoor, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, has spent ten years hauling cargo through contested orbits. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
